summary.text: David Haggan is a Republican state senator from Hampden, Maine, who has represented Senate District 10 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A former middle school social studies teacher, he served in the Maine House from 2016 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Haggan lives in Hampden, Maine, and earned a B.S. from the University of Maine in 1989.
His career experience includes working as a middle school social studies teacher, and he has been affiliated with the Anah Shrine Bangor, the NRA, and the Hampden Rifle and Pistol Club.
Haggan served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2016 to 2024 and assumed office in the Maine State Senate on December 3, 2024, succeeding Peter Lyford.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee and the Judiciary Committee, and he advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
